description.value: Donair Town is a family-run fast food chain that has been serving the Greater Vancouver area since 1993, specializing in donairs, plates, and poutine. This New Westminster location is one of four Lower Mainland outlets. A touring cyclist passing through New Westminster could grab a quick, filling meal with online or phone ordering available.
